# GEO & SEO Readiness MCP — Lite

> Open-source, MIT-licensed Model Context Protocol (stdio) server that checks whether a public website can be read and cited by AI search engines. Zero dependencies, Python 3.10+.

## Tools
- [quick_readiness_report](https://github.com/alicexixi85/geo-seo-mcp-pro#tools): runs all checks and returns a prioritized fix list
- [check_ai_crawler_access](https://github.com/alicexixi85/geo-seo-mcp-pro#tools): robots.txt rules for AI search crawlers, AI training crawlers, Googlebot and Bingbot
- [check_llms_txt](https://github.com/alicexixi85/geo-seo-mcp-pro#tools): presence and structure of /llms.txt
- [extract_structured_data](https://github.com/alicexixi85/geo-seo-mcp-pro#tools): JSON-LD types, canonical and og:url host checks
- [check_sitemap](https://github.com/alicexixi85/geo-seo-mcp-pro#tools): sitemap discovery and URL count
